idea: Continuous two-rectangle split: cut the unit square at height t into a 1×t and a 1×(1−t) rectangle and fill each with a uniform p×q (resp. p'×q') grid of side min(t/p, 1/q) (resp. min((1−t)/p', 1/q')). For every integer tuple with pq+p'q' ≥ n, solve analytically for the optimal t (a breakpoint of piecewise-linear functions), then recurse one level on the larger part.
